# Kinich Theme for DeepSeek Harness
Interactive **Kinich & Ajaw** themed UI experience for DeepSeek Harness Web / Desktop.

- Repository: https://github.com/Xian-JL/dsh-Kinich-theme
- Distribution: npm, with a GitHub Release

tarball as a fallback
- Current confirmed plugin release: `2.0.2` (npm `latest`)
- Target runtimes:
the declared DSH Web compatibility ranges and Desktop `0.2.0-rc.2`
> This is an independent community plugin and is not affiliated with or endorsed by DeepSeek or HoYo
is an independent community plugin and is not affiliated with or endorsed by DeepSeek or HoYoverse.
Custom backgrounds support automatic accents and a background-visibility slider from 0% to 100% (def
ault 75%). Higher values make DSH surfaces more transparent so the image is clearly visible.
v2.0.2 includes complex wallpaper templates, creation/history/import/export and a Profile-owned **En
able dynamic wallpaper** switch. Passive wallpapers omit explanatory text; all six settings sections
and three styles are directly accessible, and popup surfaces stay opaque. Wallpaper parameters defa
ult to 50. Off retains assets, parameters and sampled accents; static backgrounds and existing effec
ts are independent. The verified host is still **DSH 0.2.0-rc.2**, not stable DSH 0.2.0. See Specifi
cation 1.0.7 and maintenance release notes.
Since 2.0.2, DSH and settings-peer declarations are `>=0.2.0-rc.2 <0.3.0`, matching Xiao and retaini
ng the local RC.2 baseline; 0.1.x is no longer declared supported.
## Install
The current candidate `2.0.3-rc.3` adds actual-token light/dark palette previews, text/button contra
st protection, consistent Phlogiston menu/code surfaces, and image-import/manual-balance lifecycle g
uards. Pair it with Xiao `1.3.0-rc.3` through npm `next`; `latest` remains unchanged. See the develo
t with Xiao `1.3.0-rc.3` through npm `next`; `latest` remains unchanged. See the development record.
`2.0.3-rc.2` adds a Profile-local **API balance → Enable official balance monitoring** switch. It de
faults to on for backwards compatibility. Turning it off hides balance data, stops automatic/manual
checks and removes low-balance red tint and acceleration; Ajaw interactions and session feedback rem
ain available. Candidates use npm `next`, leaving `latest` unchanged.

outside this visual pass.
- The welcome page now follows the approved editorial layout: left-side we

### Visual intensity

## Settings
Open DSH **Settings → Kinich** to configure:

- Jungle (legacy modes remain configuration-compatible only)
- Minimal / Balanced / Immersive
- Kini

ch character layer
- Ajaw companion
- Natlan ornament / texture
- Dynamic environment motion
## Compatibility
`v1.8.1` supports the declared DSH releases and Desktop `0.2.0-rc.2`:
[代码示例省略，未执行]
The 0.1.6 compatibility layer understands the new `promptError`, `openError`, and `lastAgentError` s
ession fields and isolates Ajaw feedback by the session retained in DSH's main view. Legacy 0.1.5 sn
apshots remain supported.
On DSH 0.1.7, Kinich preferences use the Profile-backed live Config and `configForms` APIs. Balance
monitoring reads the official DeepSeek API-key provider's current configuration on the Host. Earlier
DSH versions continue using their settings scope.
DeepSeek Harness is still evolving quickly. If a future DSH release changes plugin APIs, use the lat
est Kinich Theme release that explicitly lists support for that DSH version.
